speaker: Doctor
text: I'm Dr. Agent, and I'll be examining you today. Can you tell me more about the fatigue, flank pain, and fever you've been experiencing, especially in relation to your recent antibiotic treatment for sinusitis?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: Do you have any pain or burning sensation when you urinate, and have you noticed any changes in the color or clarity of your urine?

speaker: Patient
text: I was first treated with amoxicillin for sinusitis and developed a rash. Then the antibiotic was changed to cephalexin for another week, and the rash went away.

speaker: Doctor
text: Did you experience any difficulty swallowing, facial swelling, or breathing problems during the rash episode? I also need to know if you have noticed any blood in your urine or joint pain.

speaker: Patient
text: I do not have nausea, vomiting, or burning with urination. I also have not noticed a major change in urine color.

speaker: Doctor
text:
REQUEST TEST: Urinalysis
REQUEST TEST: Blood_Cultures
The rash following amoxicillin followed by fever and flank pain suggests interstitial nephritis rather than a simple infection.
